terms.name: Accountable agentic commerce
terms.definition: Autonomous or semi-autonomous economic action governed by an explicit mandate, deterministic controls, inspectable execution, and reconciliation.

terms.name: AiFi
terms.definition: ARM's category label for governed AI-native financial operations across authority, budgets, wallets, payments, settlement, fulfillment, and reconciliation.

terms.name: Agent mandate
terms.definition: A documented delegation naming the principal, agent, permitted objective, resources, counterparties, limits, duration, escalation conditions, and revocation authority.

terms.name: Bounded autonomy
terms.definition: Delegated action constrained by explicit resources, counterparties, amounts, time, escalation rules, and revocation controls.

terms.name: Evidence contract
terms.definition: The required record connecting mandate and intent to policy decision, authorization, settlement, fulfillment, and exception outcome.

terms.name: Payment intent
terms.definition: The proposed economic action before authorization, including requester, resource, recipient, asset, amount, network, purpose, and expiry.

terms.name: Authorization
terms.definition: A deterministic decision that a payment intent is permitted under the active mandate and policy; it is not settlement.

terms.name: Settlement
terms.definition: The recorded completion or finalization of the value-transfer step; it does not by itself prove correct resource fulfillment.

terms.name: Fulfillment
terms.definition: Delivery of the paid resource or service under the agreed request and acceptance conditions.

terms.name: Reconciliation
terms.definition: Matching mandate, intent, authorization, execution, settlement, fulfillment, and exceptions into a reviewable record.

terms.name: x402 client
terms.definition: The application or agent that requests a paid resource and supplies a payment payload meeting an accepted requirement.

terms.name: x402 resource server
terms.definition: The service that describes a protected resource, signals payment requirements, verifies payment, and returns the resource after successful handling.

terms.name: x402 facilitator
terms.definition: A service exposing standardized verification and settlement operations for supported scheme and network combinations.

terms.name: x402 payment requirements
terms.definition: The structured description of a resource and its accepted payment choices, including scheme, network, amount, asset, recipient, and timeout data.

terms.name: x402 scheme
terms.definition: The logical method used to move value, implemented for a particular network and validated according to scheme-specific rules.

terms.name: Escalation boundary
terms.definition: The condition at which an agent must stop autonomous action and transfer the decision to a named human or higher-authority control.
